instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Say in plain words, for each of my connected accounts, which one is primary, what its sign-in allowed, what Trillion copies from it, what stays live and what Trillion may do with it", and give it connections.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:describe-connected-accounts and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give connections ([{ connection_id, vendor, service, account_label, status, connected_at, grant_scopes_known, grant_scopes, can_send, visibility, carried_by, capabilityChoices }]) and when wanted chosen ({ vendor: connection_id }, the kept primary choice), arriving ({ vendor: [labels of event sources listening] }), local_copies (connection ids a computer may keep the sign-in of) and capabilities ({ vendor: [{ id, label }] }).
